questions.explanation: Taller needs than, not that, and no more.
options: She is more tall than me.
She is more taller than me.

questions.explanation: The comparative of good is better.
options: This is more better than that.

questions.explanation: Happy changes y to i in the comparative: happier.
options: He is more happier than me.
He is most happy than me.

questions.explanation: Easy is short, so its comparative is easier, not more easy.
options: This is more easy than that.

questions.explanation: Fast is short, so its comparative is faster.
options: A plane is more fast than a train.
A plane is faster that a train.
A plane is more faster than a train.
A plane is faster than a train.
